blocks.text: Far Eastern University shocked erstwhile unbeaten University of Santo Tomas, 25-17, 21-25, 25-19, 25-19, in the knockout semifinal for its first-ever championship stint in the 2026 Shakey’s Super League (SSL) Unity Cup on Saturday at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium.
